versions.subject: Merge PR #5634 from @CheraghiMilad - Add `Kaspersky Endpoint Security Stopped Via CommandLine - Linux`
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        # Note: Add the list of shells allowed in your environment that can be used to run init.d scripts.
        - '/systemctl'
        - '/bash'
        - '/sh'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'stop'
        - 'kesl'
condition: selection
